UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$R='{{$FullRootDir}}'; $P=$R+'cs2-modded-server-master'; $S=\"$P\game\csgo\"; $C='{{$FullBaseDir}}game\csgo'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $S)){Write-Host 'Modpack not found'; exit 1}; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -LiteralPath \"$C\addons\",\"$C\cfg\settings\" -EA 0; Copy-Item \"$S\*\" $C -Recurse -Force; Copy-Item \"$S\addons\windows\*\" $C -Recurse -Force; $X=\"$C\addons\counterstrikesharp\plugins\"; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath \"$X\InventorySimulator\"){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -LiteralPath \"$X\disabled\InventorySimulator\" -EA 0; Move-Item -LiteralPath \"$X\InventorySimulator\" \"$X\disabled\"}; $G=\"$C\gameinfo.gi\"; if(-not(Select-String -LiteralPath $G -SimpleMatch 'csgo/addons/metamod' -Quiet)){(Get-Content -LiteralPath $G) -replace '^\s*Game\s*csgo\s*$',\"`t`t`tGame`tcsgo/addons/metamod`n`t`t`tGame`tcsgo\" | Set-Content -LiteralPath $G}; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force '{{$FullBaseDir}}custom_files' | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force -LiteralPath $P; Write-Host 'Modpack installed'"

-c "P=\"{{$FullRootDir}}cs2-modded-server-master/game/csgo\"; C=\"{{$FullBaseDir}}game/csgo\"; [ -d \"$P\" ] || { echo \"Modpack not found\"; exit 1; }; rm -rf \"$C/addons\" \"$C/cfg/settings\" && cp -a \"$P/.\" \"$C/\" || exit 1; X=\"$C/addons/counterstrikesharp/plugins\"; [ -d \"$X/InventorySimulator\" ] && rm -rf \"$X/disabled/InventorySimulator\" && mv \"$X/InventorySimulator\" \"$X/disabled/\"; G=\"$C/gameinfo.gi\"; grep -q csgo/addons/metamod \"$G\" || sed -i \"/^\s*Game\s*csgo\s*$/ { s//\t\t\tGame\tcsgo\/addons\/metamod\n&/ }\" \"$G\"; mkdir -p \"{{$FullBaseDir}}custom_files\"; rm -rf \"{{$FullRootDir}}cs2-modded-server-master\"; echo \"Modpack installed\""
